description: The ten modes of the comms-failure paper, in three groups by what happened to a message. The reference most annotators report; it does not cover every pattern.

groups.name: Not read
groups.definition: A post was not read: what it established drops out of what a seat acts on.

groups.name: Not binding
groups.definition: A post never became a commitment the team shares.

groups.name: Never done
groups.definition: A commitment was believed and never carried out.
